insights.summary: The agent performed an excellent optimization task, implementing high-impact caching and memory management improvements. It demonstrated a deep understanding of PyTorch performance patterns and followed all procedural requirements of the task.
strengths: Strong adherence to provided optimization patterns
weaknesses: Benchmark verification was limited by the environment's inability to run full model forward passes
Did not check for potential memory leaks in the LRU cache if maxsize was too large (though 64/256 is safe)
